title: Formal squares over the unit square separate FS-domains from RB-domains
summary: Every RB-domain is an FS-domain. Whether the converse holds was a long-standing open problem. We prove that the domain of closed axis-parallel squares in the plane whose centres lie in the unit square $[0,1]^2$, with the whole plane adjoined and ordered by reverse inclusion, is an FS-domain but not an RB-domain. The proof is quantitative.
